column2: How do I change the order of the sections and blocks of the record?
column3: Settings → Appearance → Person and animal records → “Order and visibility of blocks” (or, on a record, ⋯ → “⚙️ Arrange the sections…”, or the small ⚙️ at the end of the tabs). Drag the ⠿ handle of a section (its blocks follow it) or of a block (within its section, or onto another one: the blue line shows where it lands); with the keyboard: Tab to ⠿ then Alt + ↑ / ↓. A block’s ⋯: Move up, Move down, “Move to ▸”, Width, Hide. A section’s ⋯: Rename (or double-click its name), Change the icon, Duplicate, Folded at first, Move up, Move down, Delete (its blocks go to “No section”, “↶ Undo” puts it back). “＋ New section” at the bottom. “Editor layout: As before · New”, at the top of the page, only changes how this screen is drawn.

column2: How do I send a link that opens a record on the right tab?
column3: Copy the page’s address: it gives the record and the open section, for example “#personnes/12/famille”. When it is opened (link, reload, new window), the record opens on that tab; with a style other than “Tabs at the top”, the page scrolls down to the section and unfolds it. The browser’s ← → arrows go from one record to another. A section that no longer exists simply opens the usual tab.

column2: Does the preview in the record settings show a real record?
column3: Yes. Settings → Appearance → Person and animal records → “Preview”: the real record, in small size, with its real blocks (read-only). Choose which one in “Preview with:” (by default the last one opened; with “🐾 Animals”, an animal). It changes straight away when you change a style, the order, a width or a section. “↗ Open this record” opens it for real. Nothing is changed.

column2: I delete an animal’s record: what happens to its tracking?
column3: It goes with it: its record, its animal record, its markings, sightings, health, group and journeys. To restore everything: Settings → Change log → “Restore” on the line of the deletion. In Lists → Pets, ⋯ → “🗑 Delete” does the same. An animal whose record had been deleted before this update asks you when it opens: “↺ Restore it” or “🗑 Delete the animal”.

column2: How do I arrange a single record differently from the others?
column3: On the record: ⋯ → “⚙️ Arrange the sections…” → “For this record only”. The record shows it with a blue dot “Arrangement specific to this record”; “↺ Use the one for all records again” removes the exception (with “↶ Undo”). In Settings, the “Exception for …” frame does the same thing for the open record.

column2: Where do I put the “＋ New sighting” button of an animal’s record?
column3: Settings → Appearance → Person and animal records → “Place of “＋ New sighting””: a 👁＋ square first in the grid of buttons (at first, also arranged in “Order and visibility of buttons”), a blue button above the grid, a badge under the name, a quick-actions strip (👁＋ Sighting · 🩺＋ Health · 📍 GPS track · 🔖 Marking), a floating round button, or hidden. The O key opens the window from the record (not in a text box); it can be switched off there, or changed in Keyboard shortcuts.

column2: What does “👁 Last seen” at the top of an animal’s record mean?
column3: The last sighting of the tracked animal: “yesterday, 17:40 · 📍 place · by …” (the full date on hover, a click opens the sighting). The badge is green up to the green threshold (7 days at first), yellow after that, red “Not seen for N days” after the “not seen again” threshold (30 days), grey “Never seen since ringing” with no sighting. It is set in Settings → Appearance → Person and animal records → “Order and visibility of the header items”: place (under the name, with the badges, at the bottom of the header), thresholds, “Show the place and the person” (off: only the badge). The “not seen again” threshold is also that of the “Animals to find” block in Tracking.

column2: Where has “A person’s record” from Designs to choose from gone?
column3: It is now set in Settings → Appearance → Person and animal records → “Header shape”, just before “Order and visibility of buttons”: the same four cards (current header, photo banner, old record, identity card), the same “Extra settings” and the preview. Your previous choice is kept as it was. Designs to choose from has kept a small line that leads there.

column2: Where has the “🎨 Designs to choose from” page gone?
column3: It has been removed: its settings are now where they are used. The General style has become the “Record style” (Settings → Person and animal records, with the header shape) and now only affects the records; the left column has its own lines, corners and shadows (Menus, column and lists → Column); the page background is in Theme and colours (🧩 Page background); Movements in Accessibility → 🎞 Movement. The rest of the app keeps its original style. Your choices are kept.

column2: How are words like “born”, “died”… agreed for a person who is neither male nor female?
column3: In French, these words agree with the sex. On records of men and women (and of male or female animals), they agree by themselves. For records with the sex “Other / non-binary” or “Not given”, you choose the spelling in Settings → Theme and colours → “✍️ Word agreement”: as before (at first, nothing changes), feminine (as one says “la personne”), masculine, with a middle dot (“né·e”), in brackets (“né(e)”) or without agreement when a neutral wording exists (“Naissance le 12 mars 1888”, “Décès”). The two kinds of records are set separately, the preview shows the result straight away, and each choice is kept straight away (“↶ Undo” in the message). The setting travels with the 💾 Saved settings and the site default.

column2: How do I change the page background (squares, dots, lined paper, my photo…)?
column3: Settings → Theme and colours → “🧩 Page background”: 9 backgrounds (small squares at first, plain, dots, lined paper, graph paper, paper grain, canvas, gradient, your photo), then the size of the pattern, its intensity, its colour (pale blue, grey, main colour, sepia, your theme’s lines, a colour of your own) and the pages concerned (unticked: plain background). The preview follows straight away. Your photo stays on this computer (not in the database nor in the site default: there, plain background). These come first: Accessibility → High contrast and “One thing at a time” (plain background), and on a record the grain of the “Old paper” style. The background is never printed.

column2: How do I make text bigger (or smaller) throughout the app?
column3: Settings → Theme and colours → “Text size”: from “Very compact (13 px)” to “Very large print (32 px)”. It is the only text size setting: Accessibility → Text points to it (the old “Text size” slider in Accessibility was carried over by itself, to the nearest step). Line spacing, spacing between letters and words and the font stay in Accessibility. Simple mode, if it follows “Same as the app”, also takes this size.

column2: How do I make a genealogy of animals (a breeding)?
column3: Lists → Pets → “Base type”: 👪 Family, 🐾 Breeding or 👪🐾 Both. In Breeding, the left list, the counter at the top and the statistics start from the animals, and new records are animals; the root person (the starting record) can be an animal, and the tree then starts from it. The statistics never mix people and animals.

column2: How do I get a separate “Animals” tab?
column3: Settings → Appearance → Order of the main menu: tick “Animals” (hidden at first). Then “People” only lists people and “🐾 Animals” only animals, each with its last record opened. Without this tab, in the left list, an “🐾 Animals” frame appears between “People” and “Bookmarks” as soon as there are animals (and “People” disappears if there are only animals).

column2: How do I see the animals in the family tree?
column3: Charts → Ancestors, Descendants or Hourglass: tick “🐾 with the animals” (not ticked at first). Each person’s animals are placed under their owner, with a dotted line; a click opens their record.

column2: How do I arrange an animal’s record (show, hide, move its parts)?
column3: As for a person: Settings → Appearance → Person and animal records → “Order and visibility of blocks”, with “🐾 Animals” chosen at the top of Sections (or, on the record, ⋯ → “⚙️ Arrange the sections…”). Its six starting sections: 🪪 Record, 🔖 Rings and markings, 👁 Sightings, 🩺 Health, 👥 Group, 🗺 Map. The order you had chosen on the old animal record (“⚙️ Organise”) was carried over as it was.

column2: How do I arrange the blocks of animals’ full records without touching people’s?
column3: Settings → Appearance → Person and animal records → “Record sections”: choose “🐾 Animals”, then “Order and visibility of blocks”: the order, the width and the blocks shown for all animal records, separately from people’s records. Next to it, “Exception for…” only sets the open record. If the open record is an animal, the “PERSON RECORDS” exception is greyed out (and the other way round for a person).

column2: Where do I find an animal created from People or Animals?
column3: Everywhere: it has only one record, whether it is opened from People → Animals, Lists → Pets, the picker, a board, a house or Animal tracking.

column2: On an animal’s full record, what does “Identity” show?
column3: What matters for an animal (species, breed, sex, coat, birth, microchip…), never a person’s fields. “Edit” opens the animal’s form. Its other parts (🐾 Characteristics with identification and origins, 🌳 Pedigree, offspring, siblings, owners, 🏆 Titles and shows, 🩺 Health with weight and height, its life, its story, notes, photos, and tracking) are blocks of the record, each with ✎ to go straight to that part of the form. The “Censuses” block (and the other blocks specific to people: maternity, military, voters…) is hidden by default; you can put it back in Settings → Appearance → Person and animal records (“🐾 Animals”).

column2: How do I add a species, change their order or hide some?
column3: Lists → Pets → “⚙️ Settings” (or Settings → Animals): tick the species to show, arrange them with ↑ ↓, add your own (its name, and its icon: click it and choose one, animals first) or delete it with 🗑.

column2: How do I set up the “New animal” form (order of the parts, fields shown)?
column3: Settings → Animals → “Form”: for all animals, or for one species (“own setting” box): the order of the parts and the order of the fields in each part (↑ ↓ or by dragging ⠿), the parts and all the fields shown (the name and the species always stay). By default, the UELN number only appears for horses.

column2: How do I add my own categories and fields to an animal’s record?
column3: Settings → Animals → Form: “＋ Category” (e.g. 🧬 Genetics, Training) creates a new part of the form; “＋ Field” under a part (the app’s or yours) adds a field: short text, long text, date, number, yes / no box or list of choices (separated by ;). They are arranged and hidden like the others. On the record, an added field is shown in its part; your categories form the “🗂️ My categories” block of the full record. A deleted field keeps what was written in it (it is no longer shown).
